name: stackstra/stackstra
description: Standalone, framework-agnostic PHP helper library: types, cache, filesystem, curl, console, streams and more.

suggest.ext-mbstring: Required by Types\Chars for multibyte string handling.
suggest.ext-ctype: Required by Types\Chars for character-class checks.
suggest.ext-curl: Required by the Curl\* HTTP client subsystem.
suggest.ext-simplexml: Required by Types\XML for XML parsing.
suggest.ext-dom: Required by Types\XML for DOM-based XML handling.
suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required by Filesystem\File for MIME-type detection.
suggest.ext-posix: Required by Etc\Process for POSIX process control (Unix only).
